scientific_question: Can a group-calibrated, shift-aware selective stopping policy save substantial longitudinal observation time on completely unseen biological experiments while maintaining low premature-decision error, and do group calibration and shift refusal materially improve safety relative to simpler stopping methods?

risk_targets.selection_rule: Targets are fixed before held-out experiment evaluation and will not be changed to improve the headline.

retinal_organoid_rpe.positive: RPE_Final equals yes at the authors' final endpoint
retinal_organoid_rpe.negative: RPE_Final equals no at the authors' final endpoint

retinal_organoid_lens.positive: Lens_Final equals yes at the authors' final endpoint
retinal_organoid_lens.negative: Lens_Final equals no at the authors' final endpoint

decision_contract.erroneous_early_stop: A STOP strictly before the final scheduled observation whose predicted endpoint differs from the final endpoint.
decision_contract.false_positive_early_stop: An early STOP predicting the positive endpoint when the final endpoint is negative.
decision_contract.false_negative_early_stop: An early STOP predicting the negative endpoint when the final endpoint is positive.
decision_contract.continue: No terminal automated endpoint call has been made; acquire the next scheduled observation.
decision_contract.abstain: The unit is outside the trusted regime; disable early automation and complete the full protocol.

metric_definitions.EESR: incorrect early STOP decisions divided by all early STOP decisions
metric_definitions.FP_EESR: false-positive early STOP decisions divided by all early STOP decisions
metric_definitions.FN_EESR: false-negative early STOP decisions divided by all early STOP decisions
metric_definitions.coverage: units receiving an early STOP divided by all independent test units
metric_definitions.abstention_rate: units receiving ABSTAIN divided by all independent test units
metric_definitions.observation_savings: mean across all independent test units of the fraction of scheduled observations avoided; CONTINUE and ABSTAIN contribute zero savings
metric_definitions.observation_savings_among_stopped: mean fraction avoided among early STOP units only
metric_definitions.decision_time: first time of early STOP; final scheduled time for CONTINUE or ABSTAIN
metric_definitions.independent_sample_size: number of biological experimental units, never the number of frames

error_asymmetry.retinal_organoid: A false-negative early stop can discard an organoid that later forms the tissue of interest; a false-positive early stop can allocate downstream resources to an organoid that does not. Both are reported separately. No post-hoc weighting is used.
error_asymmetry.organoid_gemcitabine: A false positive and false negative imply different endpoint calls but neither is assigned a post-hoc cost weight. Both are reported separately.

generalization_boundary.organoid_gemcitabine: replicate rotation, retained only as feasibility evidence

claim_policy.formal_guarantee_requires: The assumptions and finite-sample bound of the chosen calibration method must hold and its bound must pass the target.
claim_policy.default_language: observed X percent EESR on held-out experiments at this operating point
